description: GNN under group lasso of 25 on gϕ's input groups, MLP(ai, aj, vi, vj), trained with one-step prediction and model noise σ (experiment 2, runs flyvis_noise_*_blank50_condl25_cv0N) on Flyvis-217, 5-fold CV. Known-ODE rows are published runs re-analysed with the current analysis code (experiment 15). Rows report prediction R2 on noise-free held-out stimuli (7,207–7,999 frames per fold) and parameter recovery: R2 on W over the fitted edges of 434,112, R2 on tau and R2 on V_rest over 13,741 neurons (outlier-corrected), and GMM clustering accuracy over 65 cell types. Columns compare σ = 0, 0.05, 0.5 against published Recurrent MLP and EED baselines. Green marks values above 0.9.
facts:
CAPTION: GNN and baselines on Flyvis-217 across three training-noise levels (σ ∈{0, 0.05, 0.5}); 5-fold CV (mean ± SD). GNN rows: the general-form GNN, gϕ = MLP(ai, aj, vi, vj) under a group lasso of 25 on its input groups, one-step training (experiment 2 of the campaign, runs flyvis_noise_*_blank50_condl25_cv0N). Known-ODE rows: the published Known-ODE runs re-analysed with the current analysis code (experiment 15). ML-baseline rows are the published ones. Prediction metrics on noise-free held-out stimuli (7,207–7,999 frames by fold for the GNN and Known-ODE rows). Parameter recovery (possible only for Known-ODE and GNN): R2 ˆ W by the per-edge template readout over the fitted edges of the 434,112; R2 ˆτ and R2 ˆV rest over all 13,741 neurons, outlier-corrected (Appendix I); GMM clustering accuracy over 65 cell types. Green: > 0.9.
FACTS:
- Known ODE: experiment 15: Known ODE re-analysed on degraded Flyvis-217 data
- GNN (ours): experiment 2: GNN MLP(ai,aj,vi,vj), group lasso, model noise
- Recurrent MLP (published): published values
- EED model (published): published values
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
